title: Windhint Configuration
description: Configuration schema for windhint — a YAML-driven batch font hinting tool for ttfautohint.

input-dir.description: Directory containing .ttf font files to hint.

output-dir.description: Directory where hinted fonts will be written.

windows-compatibility.description: Add blue zones for usWinAscent and usWinDescent to avoid clipping.

fallback-stem-width.description: Fallback stem width in font units at 2048 UPEM.

hinting-range-min.description: Minimum PPEM value for hint sets.

hinting-range-max.description: Maximum PPEM value for hint sets.

hinting-limit.description: Switch off hinting above this PPEM value; 0 means no limit.

increase-x-height.description: Increase x-height for sizes in range 6 <= PPEM <= N; 0 disables this feature.

stem-width-mode.description: Stem width mode for grayscale, GDI ClearType, and DW ClearType. A string of three letters with possible values: n (natural), q (quantized), s (strong).
